video_summary.overall_goal: Open app, view empty graph, tap add button to open entry form, fill blood pressure measurements (systolic, diastolic, pulse), add note text, save entry, navigate to statistics screen
video_summary.description: User opens Blood Pressure Monitor app, sees initial graph screen with 'Not enough data' message, taps FAB to open new measurement form, fills fields with systolic=122, diastolic=78, pulse=72, adds note 'polu', saves data, navigates to statistics/metrics view showing distribution and time-of-day polar chart

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Initial app screen with empty graph area and 'Not enough data to draw a graph' message
visible_ui_elements: FAB buttons at bottom (settings, stats, add)
steps.system_response: Screen displays initial state with empty graph

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Add/edit blood pressure entry form dialog opens after FAB tap
steps.system_response: Form dialog appears with prepopulated date/time
steps.intent_task: Open form to enter new blood pressure reading

steps.what_screen_is_visible: User enters blood pressure values into form fields
visible_ui_elements: Diastolic field with cursor and keyboard (ABC layout visible)
steps.system_response: Keyboard appears, field accepts numeric input
steps.visual_feedback: Keyboard layout changes, field remains focused

steps.what_screen_is_visible: All form fields populated with measurement data
steps.system_response: Text entry accepted in note field
steps.visual_feedback: Note field shows blue border (focused), keyboard visible below form

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Statistics screen showing data visualization after save
visible_ui_elements: Value distribution chart (red, showing systolic/diastolic/pulse bars with min/avg/max values: 85 min, 85.0 avg, 85 max)
Section: Metrics by time of day (blue polar/radar chart with 24-hour layout)
steps.system_response: Form submitted, data saved to database, app navigates to statistics screen
steps.visual_feedback: Charts render with new data, statistics displayed

overall_flow: App starts showing empty graph with 'not enough data' message
User taps FAB button to add new blood pressure measurement
Entry form appears with date/time fields pre-filled
User enters systolic (122), diastolic (78), pulse (72), and note (polu)
User submits form with save button
App navigates to statistics screen showing data distribution and time-of-day metrics
human_readable_step_summary: Graph screen displays empty state with 'Not enough data to draw a graph' message and date range selector
User taps add button (FAB) to open new entry form
Form appears with pre-filled date/time fields and empty input fields for measurements
User enters blood pressure values: systolic 122, diastolic 78, pulse 72
User taps save button to submit form
App saves data and transitions to statistics screen showing measurement distribution and metrics
